questions.question: If the radius of a cylinder is halved, what happens to its volume (assuming height remains constant)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The volume of a cylinder is directly proportional to the square of its radius: V ∝ r² × h.

Since the height (h) remains constant, the volume depends only on the radius squared: V ∝ r².

If the radius is halved (1/2), the new volume becomes (1/2)² = 1/4 of the original volume.

**∴ The correct answer is one-fourth.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius is halved, so new radius (r') = r / 2.

Height remains constant, so new height (h') = h.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder = π × r² × h

 

 
 
 
•

 V = πr²h
 

 
 
 
•

 V = 1/4 πr²h

**Calculations:**

⇒ Original Volume (V₁) = π × r² × h

⇒ New Volume (V₂) = π × (r')² × h'

⇒ V₂ = π × (r / 2)² × h

⇒ V₂ = π × (r² / 4) × h

⇒ V₂ = 1/4 × (π × r² × h)

⇒ V₂ = 1/4 × V₁

**∴ The correct answer is one-fourth.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cone

A cone with the same base radius and height as a cylinder has exactly one-third of its volume: V = 1/3 × πr²h.

Surface Area of a Cylinder

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh. Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(r + h).

Volume vs. Surface Area Dimensional Changes

If all dimensions (radius and height) of a 3D shape are scaled by a factor of *k*, the surface area scales by *k²* and the overall volume scales by *k³*.

questions.question: What is the least square number that is divisible by 8, 12, and 20?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM of 8, 12, and 20 = 120 (Prime factors: 2³ × 3¹ × 5¹)

For a perfect square, all prime factors must have even powers.

Multiply by missing factors (2¹ × 3¹ × 5¹ = 30) to make powers even.

Least square number = 120 × 30 = 3600

**∴ The correct answer is 3600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers: 8, 12, and 20

**Concept Used:**

The least perfect square divisible by a set of numbers is found by computing their LCM and multiplying it by the minimum prime factors required to make all prime powers even.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 8 = 2³

⇒ Prime factorization of 12 = 2² × 3¹

⇒ Prime factorization of 20 = 2² × 5¹

⇒ LCM (8, 12, 20) = 2³ × 3¹ × 5¹ = 120

⇒ In the prime factorization of 120, the powers of primes 2, 3, and 5 are 3, 1, and 1 respectively.

⇒ To form a perfect square, every prime factor needs to have an even power (i.e., 2⁴, 3², and 5²).

⇒ We must multiply the LCM by the missing factors: 2¹ × 3¹ × 5¹ = 30.

⇒ Required perfect square = 120 × 30 = 3600

**∴ The correct answer is 3600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The smallest positive integer that is uniformly divisible by all given numbers. It contains the highest power of all prime factors present in the individual numbers.

Perfect Square Properties

A number is a perfect square if and only if all the prime factors in its prime factorization have even exponents (e.g., n², n⁴).

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are co-prime if their Highest Common Factor (HCF) is 1. The LCM of two co-prime numbers is simply their product.
</p

questions.question: If the amount is Rs. 600 and the Principal is Rs. 450, which is compounded yearly for 1 year, calculate the rate of interest.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For 1 year, Compound Interest is equal to Simple Interest.

Interest = Amount − Principal = 600 − 450 = Rs. 150

Rate % = (Interest ÷ Principal) × 100

⇒ Rate % = (150 ÷ 450) × 100 = 1/3 × 100 = 33.33%

**∴ The correct answer is 33.33%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
•

 1 Year

**Given:**

Amount (A) = Rs. 600

Principal (P) = Rs. 450

Time (t) = 1 year

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)t

**Calculation:**

⇒ 600 = 450 × (1 + R/100)¹

⇒ 600 ÷ 450 = 1 + R/100

⇒ 4/3 = 1 + R/100

⇒ R/100 = 4/3 − 1

⇒ R/100 = 1/3

⇒ R = 100/3

⇒ R = 33.33%

**∴ The correct answer is 33.33%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

First Year Interest Property

For the first year, when compounding is done annually, Compound Interest (CI) and Simple Interest (SI) are perfectly equal since the interest is calculated only on the initial principal.

Compound Interest Formula

Amount = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ, where P = Principal, R = Rate of interest, and n = Time period.

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where T is the given time period in years.
</p

Effective Rate Method for Simple Interest

For simple interest, the total percentage interest earned is simply the product of Rate and Time. Effective Rate = R × T.

Compound Interest (CI)

Difference Between SI and CI

For the first year, SI and CI are identical when compounded annually. From the second year onwards, CI becomes progressively larger than SI due to interest earned on accumulated interest.

questions.question: A person crosses a 700 m long street in 5 minutes. What is his speed in km per hour?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time in seconds = 5 × 60 = 300 s

Speed = Distance ÷ Time = 700 ÷ 300 = 7/3 m/s

To convert m/s into km/h directly multiply by 18/5.

Speed in km/h = (7/3) × (18/5) = 42/5 = 8.4 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 8.4 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance = 700 m

Time = 5 minutes

 
• 
 
 
 Distance = 700 m (0.7 km)
 Time = 5 min (1/12 hr)
 Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ First, convert distance into kilometres (km):

⇒ Distance = 700 m = 700 ÷ 1000 = 0.7 km

⇒ Next, convert time into hours (hr):

⇒ Time = 5 mins = 5 ÷ 60 = 1/12 hours

⇒ Now substitute the values into the formula:

⇒ Speed = 0.7 ÷ (1/12)

⇒ Speed = 0.7 × 12

⇒ Speed = 8.4 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 8.4 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Conversion Factor for Speed

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply the speed by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply the speed by 18/5.

Average Speed

Average speed is the ratio of the total distance travelled to the total time taken (Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time).

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds (S₁ − S₂). In opposite directions, it is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂).
</p

questions.question: A hollow rectangular parallelepiped has external dimensions 12 cm × 10 cm × 8 cm and a thickness of 1 cm. Find its volume.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The volume of the material of a hollow shape is the difference between its external and internal volumes.

To find internal dimensions, subtract twice the thickness from each external dimension: (12 − 2), (10 − 2), (8 − 2).

Internal dimensions = 10 cm, 8 cm, and 6 cm.

Volume = External Volume − Internal Volume

Volume = (12 × 10 × 8) − (10 × 8 × 6) = 960 − 480 = 480 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 480 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

External length (L) = 12 cm

External breadth (B) = 10 cm

External height (H) = 8 cm

Thickness (t) = 1 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of material = External Volume − Internal Volume

Internal dimensions = (L − 2t) × (B − 2t) × (H − 2t)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Internal length = 12 − 2(1) = 10 cm

⇒ Internal breadth = 10 − 2(1) = 8 cm

⇒ Internal height = 8 − 2(1) = 6 cm

⇒ External Volume = 12 × 10 × 8 = 960 cm³

⇒ Internal Volume = 10 × 8 × 6 = 480 cm³

⇒ Volume of the parallelepiped = 960 − 480 = 480 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 480 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cuboid

The total surface area of a solid rectangular parallelepiped is calculated as 2(lb + bh + hl) where l, b, and h are the length, breadth, and height respectively.

Body Diagonal of a Cuboid

The length of the longest possible rod that can be placed perfectly inside a cubical room is its body diagonal given by √(l² + b² + h²).

Volume of a Hollow Cylinder

Applying the same fundamental logic, the volume of material in a hollow pipe or cylinder is given by πh(R² − r²), where R is the outer radius and r is the inner radius.
</p

questions.question: A sector of radius 14 cm has an area of 154 cm². Find the angle of the sector.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of a full circle = πr² = (22 ÷ 7) × 14 × 14 = 616 cm².

The given area of the sector is 154 cm².

Ratio of the sector area to the full circle area = 154 ÷ 616 = 1 ÷ 4.

Since the area is proportional to the central angle, the angle must be 1/4 of a full circle (360°).

⇒ Sector angle = 360° × (1 ÷ 4) = 90°.

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 r = 14 cm
 Area = 154 sq cm

**Given:**

Radius of the sector (r) = 14 cm

Area of the sector = 154 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Area of sector = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr²

**Calculations:**

⇒ 154 = (θ ÷ 360°) × (22 ÷ 7) × 14 × 14

⇒ 154 = (θ ÷ 360°) × 22 × 2 × 14

⇒ 154 = (θ ÷ 360°) × 616

⇒ θ ÷ 360° = 154 ÷ 616

⇒ θ ÷ 360° = 1 ÷ 4

⇒ θ = 360° × (1 ÷ 4)

⇒ θ = 90°

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Sector

The area of a sector of a circle with radius r and central angle θ is given by the formula: Area = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr².

Length of an Arc

The length of the boundary arc of the sector is proportional to the central angle and is calculated as: Arc Length (l) = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr.

Perimeter of a Sector

The total perimeter of a sector includes the curved arc length and the two straight radii. Formula: Perimeter = l + 2r.

questions.question: The difference between 20% of a number and 10% of the same number is 120. What is the number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the required original number be 100%.

Difference in percentage = 20% − 10% = 10%

Given the difference is 120, we can say:

10% → 120

100% → 120 × 10 = 1200

**∴ The correct answer is 1200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The difference between 20% of a number and 10% of the same number is 120.

**Formula Used:**

Value = Base Number × (Percentage ÷ 100)

 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 
 10%
 10%
 Remaining 80%
 
 

 Diff = 120
 
 

 Total (100%) = 1200

**Calculation:**

Let the required number be x.

⇒ 20% of x − 10% of x = 120

⇒ (20 − 10)% of x = 120

⇒ 10% of x = 120

⇒ (10 ÷ 100) × x = 120

⇒ x = 120 × (100 ÷ 10)

⇒ x = 120 × 10

⇒ x = 1200

**∴ The correct answer is 1200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Base Reference

When solving percentage differences or sums, ensure that the percentages are being applied to the exact same base number before combining them mathematically.

Base Percentage Conversion

To rapidly convert a percentage into a fraction for simplified calculation, simply divide by 100 (for example, 10% is equal to 1/10 and 20% is equal to 1/5).

Finding the Original Amount

If p% of a number is given as y, the original whole number can be instantly deduced using the unitary approach format: Number = (y × 100) ÷ p.
</p

questions.question: A buyer gets two successive discounts of 20% and 10% on a Rs. 1000 item. What is the price paid?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective single discount for 20% and 10% = 20 + 10 − (20 × 10)/100 = 28%.

Final Selling Price = 100% − 28% = 72% of Marked Price.

Final Price = (72/100) × 1000 = 720.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹720.**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹1000

questions.question: A container has 60 litres of a mixture of acid and water in the ratio 7:3. 20% of the mixture is taken out and replaced with water. This operation is repeated once more. What is the final percentage of acid in the mixture?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial acid percentage = (7 ÷ 10) × 100% = 70%

Removing 20% of the mixture and replacing it with water leaves 80% (or 0.8) of the acid behind each time.

Since the replacement operation is performed 2 times successively:

Final Acid Percentage = 70% × 0.8 × 0.8 = 44.8%

**∴ The correct answer is 44.8%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total quantity of mixture = 60 L

Ratio of acid to water = 7 : 3

Volume of mixture removed and replaced = 20% of 60 L = 12 L

Number of operations (n) = 2

**Formula Used:**

Final Quantity = Initial Quantity × [1 − (Replacement Volume ÷ Total Volume)]ⁿ

 
 Initial Mix
 Acid: 42 L
 Water: 18 L

 
• 
 

 −20%
 +20%

 
 Step 1
 Acid: 33.6 L
 Water: 26.4 L

 
• 
 

 −20%
 +20%

 
 Step 2
 Acid: 26.88 L
 Water: 33.12 L

 Replacement Process Timeline
 Final Acid = 26.88 L (44.8% of 60 L)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Initial quantity of acid = (7 ÷ 10) × 60 = 42 L

⇒ Final quantity of acid = 42 × [1 − (12 ÷ 60)]²

⇒ Final quantity of acid = 42 × [1 − 1/5]²

⇒ Final quantity of acid = 42 × (4 / 5)² = 42 × (16 ÷ 25)

⇒ Final quantity of acid = 672 ÷ 25 = 26.88 L

⇒ Final percentage of acid = (Final quantity of acid ÷ Total volume) × 100

⇒ Final percentage of acid = (26.88 ÷ 60) × 100 = 268.8 ÷ 6 = 44.8%

**∴ The correct answer is 44.8%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Repeated Replacement Formula

When a volume y is repeatedly taken out from a total mixture x and replaced by another liquid for n times, the remaining quantity of the original liquid = Initial Quantity × (1 − y/x)ⁿ.

Successive Percentage Method

Removing a fixed percentage repeatedly applies the successive percentage formula: Net Change = a + b − (a × b)/100. For example, two successive 20% decreases yield a net decrease of 20 + 20 − (20 × 20)/100 = 36%.

Alligation Rule

This rule helps find the ratio in which two ingredients at different concentrations are mixed to achieve a desired average concentration. Formula: Ratio = (Dearer − Mean) : (Mean − Cheaper).
</p

questions.question: The efficiency of A, B and C is 2 : 3 : 5. A alone can complete the work in 40 days. They all worked together for 5 days and then C left the work. In how many days can A and B together complete the remaining work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = Efficiency of A × Days taken by A = 2 × 40 = 80 units.

Work done by A, B, and C together in 5 days = (2 + 3 + 5) × 5 = 50 units.

Remaining work = 80 − 50 = 30 units.

Time taken by A and B to complete remaining work = 30 ÷ (2 + 3) = 6 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 6 days.**

questions.question: A triangular prism has base side lengths 5 cm, 6 cm, and 7 cm and height 10 cm. What is its lateral surface area?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any prism, the Lateral Surface Area (LSA) is given by the perimeter of its base multiplied by its height.

⇒ Base Perimeter = 5 + 6 + 7 = 18 cm

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 18 × 10 = 180 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 180 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side lengths of the triangular base = 5 cm, 6 cm, and 7 cm

Height of the prism (h) = 10 cm

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 

 

 

 

 h = 10 cm
 
 6 cm
 5 cm
 7 cm
 
 Lateral Surface Area
 = Base Perimeter × h

**Formula Used:**

Lateral Surface Area of a Prism = Perimeter of Base × Height

**Calculation:**

⇒ Perimeter of the triangular base = 5 + 6 + 7 = 18 cm

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 18 × 10

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 180 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 180 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Prism

The Total Surface Area is the sum of the Lateral Surface Area and the area of the two bases: TSA = LSA + 2 × Base Area.

Volume of a Prism

The volume of any prism is equal to the area of its base multiplied by its height: Volume = Base Area × Height.

Euler's Formula for Polyhedrons

For any convex polyhedron (like a prism), the number of faces (F), vertices (V), and edges (E) are related by: F + V = E + 2.
</p

questions.question: A cone of radius 9 cm and height 12 cm is cut into two parts by a plane parallel to its base, at a height of 4 cm from the vertex. Find the volume of the frustum formed.
questions.solution:

questions.question: If sinx = cos(3x - 20°), what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any two acute angles, if sin A = cos B, then the sum of the angles is always 90°.

⇒ x + (3x − 20°) = 90°

⇒ 4x = 110°

⇒ x = 27.5°

**∴ The correct answer is 27.5°.**

sin x = cos (3x − 20°)

sin θ = cos (90° − θ)

 sin(x) = cos(3x − 20°) ⇒ x + 3x − 20° = 90°

**Calculation:**

⇒ cos (90° − x) = cos (3x − 20°)

Comparing the angles on both sides:

⇒ 90° − x = 3x − 20°

⇒ 90° + 20° = 3x + x

⇒ 110° = 4x

⇒ x = 110° ÷ 4

⇒ x = 27.5°

Complementary Angles

Two angles are complementary if their sum is 90°. Key trigonometric pairs that follow this rule are: sin θ = cos (90° − θ), tan θ = cot (90° − θ), and sec θ = cosec (90° − θ).

Supplementary Angles

Two angles are supplementary if their sum is exactly 180°. The corresponding trigonometric rules are sin (180° − θ) = sin θ and cos (180° − θ) = −cos θ.

Basic Pythagorean Identities

The most commonly used identity is sin²θ + cos²θ = 1. Others include sec²θ − tan²θ = 1 and cosec²θ − cot²θ = 1.

questions.question: In a right triangle, one of the acute angles is 30°. What is the measure of the exterior angle at the right-angled vertex?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In any triangle, the interior and exterior angles at a single vertex form a linear pair, meaning they add up to 180°.

At the right-angled vertex, the interior angle is always exactly 90°.

Therefore, Exterior Angle = 180° − Interior Angle = 180° − 90° = 90°.

The given acute angle of 30° is distractor information and is not required for the calculation.

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A right-angled ΔABC with the right angle at vertex B (∠B = 90°).

One acute angle, say ∠C = 30°.

**Formula Used:**

Sum of interior angles of a triangle = 180°

Exterior angle = Sum of two opposite interior angles

**Calculations:**

⇒ In ΔABC, ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ ∠A + 90° + 30° = 180°

⇒ ∠A = 180° − 120° = 60°

⇒ The exterior angle at vertex B is equal to the sum of the opposite interior angles (∠A and ∠C).

⇒ Exterior ∠B = ∠A + ∠C

⇒ Exterior ∠B = 60° + 30° = 90°

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exterior Angle Property

The exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of the two opposite interior angles. Formula: Exterior ∠ = Interior ∠₁ + Interior ∠₂.

Linear Pair Axiom

When a straight line is intersected by a ray, the adjacent angles form a linear pair and sum up to 180°. Thus, Interior ∠ + Exterior ∠ = 180°.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all three interior angles of a triangle is exactly 180°. In a right-angled triangle, the two non-right angles are always complementary (their sum is exactly 90°).
</p

questions.question: A triangle with all its angles less than 90° has its Orthocenter located where?

A triangle with all its angles less than 90° is called an acute-angled triangle.

By standard geometric properties, the altitudes of an acute-angled triangle always lie entirely within the boundary of the shape.

questions.question:
**Rationalize**:

(√2+√3)/(√2-√3)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an expression of the form (√a + √b) ÷ (√a − √b), the result is directly [(a + b + 2√ab) ÷ (a − b)].

Here, a = 2 and b = 3.

Result = (2 + 3 + 2√6) ÷ (2 − 3)

Result = (5 + 2√6) ÷ (−1) = −5 − 2√6

**∴ The correct answer is −5 − 2√6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = (√2 + √3) ÷ (√2 − √3)

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a − b) × (a + b) = a² − b²

**Calculation:**

⇒ To rationalize the denominator, multiply the numerator and denominator by the conjugate of the denominator, i.e., (√2 + √3).

⇒ [(√2 + √3) × (√2 + √3)] ÷ [(√2 − √3) × (√2 + √3)]

⇒ (√2 + √3)² ÷ [(√2)² − (√3)²]

⇒ [(√2)² + (√3)² + 2 × √2 × √3] ÷ (2 − 3)

⇒ (2 + 3 + 2√6) ÷ (−1)

⇒ (5 + 2√6) ÷ (−1)

⇒ −5 − 2√6

**∴ The correct answer is −5 − 2√6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rationalization Factor

The rationalizing factor of (√a − √b) is its conjugate (√a + √b). Multiplying them removes the root terms from the denominator.

Surd Multiplication Rule

When multiplying two square roots, the numbers inside the roots are multiplied together: √a × √b = √(ab).

Difference of Squares

The core identity used in rationalization is (a − b)(a + b) = a² − b². For surds, this directly eliminates the square root signs.
</p

According to the Basic Proportionality Theorem, a line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides proportionally.

AD / DB = AE / EC

**Given:**

In ΔABC, DE is parallel to BC (DE || BC).

Lengths of the segments are given as AD = 3, DB = 6, and AE = 4.

**Formula Used:**

Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales Theorem): If a line intersects two sides of a triangle and is parallel to the third side, then it divides the two sides in the same ratio.

Formula: AD / DB = AE / EC

**Calculations:**

⇒ AD / DB = AE / EC

⇒ 3 / 6 = 4 / EC

Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT)

If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle intersecting the other two sides, it divides them in the same ratio. This implies AD / DB = AE / EC.

Similar Triangles Property

When a line DE is parallel to the base BC, ΔADE becomes similar to ΔABC. The ratio of all corresponding sides is strictly equal: AD / AB = AE / AC = DE / BC.

Midpoint Theorem

A specific scenario of BPT: If a line segment connects the exact midpoints of two sides of a triangle, it is parallel to the third side and its length is exactly half of the third side.
</p

questions.question: If tan A + sec A = 3, find tan A.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If sec A + tan A = x, then sec A − tan A = 1 / x.

Subtracting the two equations, we get: 2 tan A = x − (1 / x).

Given sec A + tan A = 3, so x = 3.

⇒ 2 tan A = 3 − (1 / 3) = 8 / 3

⇒ tan A = 4 / 3

**∴ The correct answer is 4/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ sec A + tan A = 3

**Formula Used:**

⇒ sec A = 1 / cos A

⇒ tan A = sin A / cos A

⇒ sin² A + cos² A = 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ (1 / cos A) + (sin A / cos A) = 3

⇒ (1 + sin A) / cos A = 3

Squaring both sides:

⇒ (1 + sin A)² / cos² A = 9

⇒ (1 + sin A)² / (1 − sin² A) = 9

⇒ (1 + sin A)² / [(1 − sin A) × (1 + sin A)] = 9

⇒ (1 + sin A) / (1 − sin A) = 9

⇒ 1 + sin A = 9 − 9 sin A

⇒ 10 sin A = 8

⇒ sin A = 8 / 10 = 4 / 5

⇒ In a right-angled triangle, sin A = Opposite / Hypotenuse = 4 / 5

⇒ Opposite = 4, Hypotenuse = 5

⇒ Adjacent = √(5² − 4²) = √(25 − 16) = √9 = 3

⇒ tan A = Opposite / Adjacent = 4 / 3

**∴ The correct answer is 4/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Trigonometric Identities

⇒ sin² θ + cos² θ = 1 | sec² θ − tan² θ = 1 | cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1

Reciprocal Pair Logic

Since sec² θ − tan² θ = 1, the expressions (sec θ + tan θ) and (sec θ − tan θ) are always reciprocals of each other.

Cosecant and Cotangent Property

Similarly, if cosec θ + cot θ = x, then cosec θ − cot θ = 1 / x.

questions.question: A, B, and C together can complete a task in 6 days. If A alone takes 12 days and B alone takes 18 days, how long will C alone take?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM of 6, 12, 18 = 36 units.

Combined efficiency of A, B and C = 36 ÷ 6 = 6 units/day.

Efficiency of A = 36 ÷ 12 = 3 units/day, Efficiency of B = 36 ÷ 18 = 2 units/day.

Efficiency of C = Total efficiency − (A + B) = 6 − (3 + 2) = 1 unit/day.

Time taken by C alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of C = 36 ÷ 1 = 36 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 36 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A, B, and C together = 6 days

Time taken by A alone = 12 days

Time taken by B alone = 18 days

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of C = (Combined efficiency of A, B, C) − (Efficiency of A + Efficiency of B)

⇒ Efficiency of C = 6 − (3 + 2) = 1 unit/day

⇒ Time required by C alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of C

⇒ Time required by C alone = 36 ÷ 1 = 36 days

**∴ The correct answer is 36 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns

Follows the exact same LCM logic as Time & Work. Inlet pipes have positive efficiency, and outlet pipes (leaks) have negative efficiency.

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed strictly in the ratio of the total work done by each person. If all work together for the same number of days, wages are distributed in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Alternate Day Work

When people work on alternate days, find the total work done in a full cycle (e.g., 2 days for 2 people) and multiply it to reach close to the total work, then add the remaining days individually.
</p
